title: Story log: where to stand for four curated places
body:
Follow-up to #77. After the big retake, 18 of the 22 curated changes had an "after" photo inside the thing. Four didn't:
- **23a878f and 5f0f9e7 (Oct 18 scenes):** the map was laid out differently then, so the rabbit stood at today's lemon and a neighbor answered instead. They now stand where those builds put the lemons, which I read from each build's dev hooks.
- **#31 and #62 (Ham):** he was about two tiles away, just out of reach. They now stand a tile further north.

I tested all four on their real builds, and each one gets in.

`placesMoved` (and a redo's same-places check) now also compares where to stand, so changing a ` @ lat, lon` retakes that photo. Before, it only noticed a changed place. The push run's `--curated` will retake these four.

473 tests pass, including a new one for the standing-spot rule.
